description_expanded: Bella Luna is a charming two-story guest house tucked off Scenic 30A with two bedrooms, two full baths, and accommodations for four gulf-going guests in the historic Grayton Beach . It is part of the family compound known as Magnolia House , which includes the main house,  Goodnight Moon , and carriage house  together  that may be value booked for larger beach reunions to accommodate 11 carefree guests. The exteriors of Bella Luna have a beguiling Old Florida-styled design, while the interiors feature a bright, spacious look with soaring cathedral ceilings and two walls of sunny windows. Light brown hardwood flooring flows throughout, providing a warm coastal-styled accent to the white-painted wooden walls. A cream-colored couch on one side faces a large flatscreen TV for entertainment mounted above a built-in white cabinet that spans its width with two stylish lamps at each end. Nearby, a kitchen island table with a butcher block wooden top is flanked by two sleek white fashionable vintage modern bucket chairs to enjoy favorite drinks and appetizers. The sunny kitchen has a wall of windows, contemporary white cabinetry with ashy gray stone countertops, brushed stainless steel appliances, and a retro-style turquoise refrigerator freezer.  A sliding barn door leads into a sunny guest bedroom on the first floor with colorful décor, a king-size bed with a creamy white decorative metal frame, and a wall-mounted flatscreen TV. It has an ensuite bath with a gray granite-topped sink vanity and a walk-in shower. The bright primary bedroom is upstairs with a king-size bed beneath a decorative driftwood wall hanging facing a wall of windows. Its ensuite bath includes a gray granite-topped vanity sink and a wide glass-walled walk-in shower. This desirable  Grayton Beach locale is a short stroll from the historic village center, where visitors can enjoy the famous Red Bar offering great food, craft cocktails, wine, beer, and live musical entertainment. The unique Zoo Gallery is across the street with a vibrant array of colorful decorative art, jewelry, and beach-inspired furnishings created by artists worldwide. The Tribe Kelley Surf Post next door offers an awesome array of chic coastal clothing and fashionable hand-selected accouterments. Chiringo’s restaurant down the block features Spanish Tapas, fresh local seafood, favorite drinks, and seasonal entertainment. The renowned AJ’s Seafood & Oyster Bar is also within easy walking distance and features delectable gulf-caught entrees and rollicking live dance bands every night of the week. Many other restaurants, friendly beach bars, boutiques, artist galleries, amphitheater concerts, and fun festivals are minutes away in the renowned Seaside and the acclaimed Santa Rosa Beach coastal village center of Gulf Place . First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen with Eat-In Dining, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Laundry. Second Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower.
